Mockup

Flatter course navigation with a persistent unit rail

This mockup treats each key stage as one course section first. Students land on a course overview, keep the unit list visible on the left, and open deeper resources inside the current unit instead of stepping through multiple button pages.

What changes

  • Course overview becomes the landing page
  • Unit overview and learning objectives are always the first view
  • Subtopic links live in the main panel, not in a sprawling nested menu
  • Deep pages should always link back to the unit and the course explicitly

Navigator

KS3

Course overview first, lesson sequence second

Students land on a course overview page with unit summaries, expectations, and a persistent unit rail. Unit pages then open with overview + objectives before the deeper lesson resources appear.

Scale rule Typical path target: 2 clicks to a unit, 3 clicks to a deep lesson resource
Sidebar rule Only the active unit is expanded
Main-panel rule Subtopics live here, not in nested side menus

Course overview content

  • One course landing page per key stage instead of another button wall
  • Unit overview and objectives visible as the default state
  • Lesson, textbook, activity, and assessment links stay inside the same unit context

Navigation principles

  • One open unit in the sidebar at a time
  • Deeper links appear in the main content pane, not nested in the sidebar
  • Students can always jump sideways to another unit without backing out repeatedly

KS4

Paper structure becomes a course overview, not a second navigation maze

The course landing page holds the paper split, syllabus language, and quick orientation. The left rail then becomes a stable list of topics, while the main pane handles subtopics, textbook, slides, activities, and assessments.

Scale rule Typical path target: 2 clicks to a topic, 3 clicks to a slide deck or worksheet
Sidebar rule Only the active unit is expanded
Main-panel rule Subtopics live here, not in nested side menus

Course overview content

  • Topic list stays visible across the whole course
  • The selected topic always opens to overview + objectives first
  • Subtopic slide decks and tasks appear as an in-page sequence rather than a deeper route tree

Navigation principles

  • Paper 1 and Paper 2 stay visible as context labels, not separate navigation branches
  • Remove dead-end buttons that only send students to another chooser page
  • Use one sticky sidebar, one main work area, one current topic state

KS5

One IB section with pathway context, persistent units, and direct resource access

Students enter one IB section first. Pathway context such as HL or SL stays visible in the unit labels, while the left rail exposes every unit and the main pane handles subtopics, worksheets, slide decks, textbook, and revision without repeated backtracking.

Scale rule Typical path target: 2 clicks to a unit, 3 clicks to a worksheet or slide deck
Sidebar rule Only the active unit is expanded
Main-panel rule Subtopics live here, not in nested side menus

Course overview content

  • Course overview first, then direct unit entry
  • Unit overview and objectives become the default state of every unit
  • Subtopic decks and activities are surfaced as a sequence inside the active unit

Navigation principles

  • Pathway labels stay attached to each unit title
  • One open unit in the sidebar prevents the menu from sprawling
  • Worksheets, textbook, slides, and revision stay inside the same unit context
